parts:
Hi Jairo,

Thank you very much for your response and support. Unfortunately, this error is occurring across all of our data. I’m wondering if the issue might be related to the configurations we applied for the study protocols, where participants did not wear the accelerometer at night.

Before applying these configurations, the script ran, but the wake-up and sleep times were inaccurate. After making the adjustments to account for the non-wear periods at night, the script no longer works & the previously described error message occurs.

Is there another configuration I could try that still accounts for the fact that participants didn’t wear the accelerometer at night, but also ensures the script runs correctly?

Additionally, I reached out to movisens, and they mentioned that the main difference between the Move 3 and Move 4 is the inclusion of a gyroscope in the Move 4. The data is stored similarly to the Move 3, but there is an additional "angularrate.bin" file. Does GGIR use this data for calculations, or would it be irrelevant for the analysis?

Thank you again for your time and help!

Best regards,
Tim Balder

messages.subject: Re: Error in GGIR Package "Non-numeric argument for mathematical function" part 5
parts:
Hi all,

After further investigation, the error that Tim was getting was not related with the reading of the move3 sensor files, but to the configuration of the parameters in the GGIR function, i.e., using the "HorAngle" algorithm without specifying the "longitudinal_axis", and without calculating the three axes' angles in part 1. Part 5 did not include any angle estimate in the time series (as the angles were not calculated in part 1), and therefore it crashed when trying to use the angle to add the SIBs indicator to the time series.

Best,
Jairo
